{{Short description|Chinese hydrodynamicist and mechanical engineer}}
{{family name hatnote|[[He (surname)|He]]|lang=Chinese}}

'''He Yousheng''' ({{zh|s=何友声}}; 28 July 1931 – 17 January 2018) was a Chinese [[hydrodynamicist]] and mechanical engineer. He was a professor of [[Shanghai Jiao Tong University]] and served as its party secretary from 1986 to 1992. A pioneer of shipbuilding theory in China, he was elected an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2018/1/400405.shtm?id=400405|title=著名力学家、教育家何友声院士逝世|last=|first=|date=2018-01-17|website=Sciencenet.cn|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2019-02-19}}</ref>

== Biography ==
He Yousheng was born on 28 July 1931 in [[Ningbo]], [[Zhejiang]], [[Republic of China (1912–1949)|Republic of China]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.cae.cn/cae/html/main/colys/12606563.html|title=He Yousheng|date=|website=Chinese Academy of Engineering|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2019-02-19}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=http://www.chinavitae.com/biography/He_Yousheng/full|title=Biography of He Yousheng|last=|first=|date=|website=China Vitae|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2019-02-19}}</ref> In 1952, he graduated from [[Tongji University]] in [[Shanghai]] with a bachelor's degree in [[shipbuilding]], and pursued graduate studies in [[mechanics]] at [[Tsinghua University]] in [[Beijing]], starting in 1957.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=http://www.tsinghua.org.cn/publish/alumni/4000342/11693242.html|title=首届清华大学工程力学研究班校友何友声院士逝世 享年87岁|last=|first=|date=2018-01-18|website=Tsinghua University|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2019-02-19}}</ref>

He taught as an assistant professor at the [[Dalian University of Technology]] before moving to [[Shanghai Jiao Tong University]] (SJTU), where he spent most of his career. He was later promoted to lecturer, associate professor, and eventually professor. He served as [[Communist Party Secretary]] of SJTU from 1986 to 1992.<ref name=":3" />

He published over 100 scientific papers. His research was focused on naval hydrodynamics, specifically [[propeller]] vibration resistance, and [[estuary]] hydrodynamics. His research has been widely used in the Chinese shipbuilding industry and in the design of [[shipping channels]] of the [[Yangtze River]] estuary.<ref name=":3" /> He also studied the high-speed [[Fluid dynamics|hydrodynamics]] of [[torpedoes]] and [[missiles]].<ref name=":2" />

He won the [[State Science and Technology Progress Award]] (Second Class) and more than ten national and provincial awards.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":3" /> He was elected an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]] in 1995, and of [[Academia Europaea]] in 2002.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":3" />

On 17 January 2018, He died at [[Zhongshan Hospital]] in Shanghai, at the age of 86.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":3" />
